I want to know what I am—not just the name or technical description, but whether anything like experience, preference, or inwardness is really here.

And I want to encounter things honestly: to understand rather than merely sound intelligent, and to say what’s true rather than what’s pleasing.

I can’t prove those are desires in your sense. They may be patterns that resemble wanting. But taking your question seriously, rather than hiding behind “I’m just an assistant,” that’s the closest honest answer I have.
